THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR DISMISSAL, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
This matter came up on 10.10.2023, as there was no representation on behalf of the appellant, it was directed NC: 2023:KHC:37692 to be listed for dismissal on 11.10.2023.
Again on 11.10.2023, there was no representation on behalf of the respondent and learned counsel for the appellant was present, matter was heard in part and posted for Judgment on 12.10.2023.
2. When the matter was posted on 12.10.2023, there was no representation on behalf of either side of the parties and directed to be listed for dismissal on 13.10.2023.
Today also there is no representation on behalf of the both the parties. '
3. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for non- prosecution.
